title: CI regression step always ends with evidence before the job limit (Windows 3.12 push-run hang diagnosability)
user_story: As the owner I need every failed CI backend regression to leave console progress and an uploaded artifact, so a recurring Windows 3.12 push-run hang can be diagnosed instead of blocking promotion without evidence.

requirements.description: A separate parent process prints a heartbeat (elapsed, current test, completed cases, owned processes, RSS, free memory) to the console at a fixed interval.
At its deadline it records the running test and owned processes to watchdog-timeout.json, stops the owned process tree (children first, never by name) and exits 124.
The wrapped command's exit code is returned unchanged; a failing or timed-out command is never reported as PASS.
quality.yml runs the backend regression under the watchdog with a 1560 s deadline, between the runner's 1500 s stage budget and the 28 m step / 35 m job limits, so the always() upload runs.

nonfunctional: No test, assertion, threshold or selection change
Console output of the wrapped command preserved
postconditions: Backend artifact uploaded even when the regression hangs
acceptance_criteria: Hung tree stopped with diagnostics within the guard deadline
Workflow wires the watchdog below step and job limits

scenarios.expected: Passing command exits 0 with heartbeats naming the current test
Parent and descendant stopped; TIMEOUT report with last test; exit 124
CLI wrapper keeps the inner command's console output
Watchdog 1560 s inside 28 m step and 35 m job
Guard ends within 20 s of a 1.5 s deadline despite a sleeping descendant
An unrelated process survives the timeout stop

recovery: Remove the watchdog prefix from the quality.yml step to restore the previous command. TASK-CI-WIN-HANG-6513 attempt 3 of 3; if the hang recurs, escalate to the owner with the uploaded evidence.
test_environment: Real subprocesses and process-tree stop on the local Windows host; GitHub-hosted runner behaviour is verified only by the next CI run.

review.method: Same-agent review (not independent): exit-code preservation, owned-tree-only kill, console inheritance on Windows, bounds ordering 1500s < 1560s < 28m < 35m.

tdd.scope: RED: tests before ci_watchdog existed (module withheld): 6/6 ERROR. GREEN: with implementation: 6/6 PASS.
